mismatch.finding: Native creation is a fixed preset: public visibility, solo, first trivia category, start in 10 minutes, 30 places (TournoisScreen.tsx createTournament call with visibility: 'public'). Private PIN rooms, school/grade team rules, category choice and scheduling are web-only, while the web arcade advertises private class rooms and PAR-04 expects phone organizers.
mismatch.recommendation: Implement private/PIN visibility and a start-time choice in native creation (preferred: PAR-02/PAR-04), or declare native creation as "quick public tournament" in the PAR-09 limitations and link to the web form for private rooms.
mismatch.resolution: Resolved 2026-10-19: native creation (TournoisCreateForm) now offers every web option — format (live/window/rounds/bracket), categories, question count and seconds, start date+time with schedule preview, window/round/bracket lengths and size, solo/school/grade team rule with counted players, public/unlisted/private PIN visibility and organiser-plays — plus the one-tap "Rapide" public preset. Both platforms build the body with shared/tournois/creationInput.creationPayload and the app checks it with the server validator before sending; after a private/unlisted room is created the PIN is shown large with copy/share and the /tournois/rejoindre?pin= link. Join-by-PIN already existed natively. Copy is via the system share sheet and long-press text selection (no clipboard native module in the OTA runtime). Evidence: mobile tournoisCreate.test.ts, tournoisCreateForm.test.tsx; installed-device run still pending.
